# Doha Roastery | دوحة روستري

> Doha Roastery is a specialty coffee roastery based in Doha, Qatar. It serves individuals and supplies cafes, hotels, and restaurants across Qatar.

## Official information

- Website: https://www.doharoastery.com
- Products: https://www.doharoastery.com/products
- Coffee tools: https://www.doharoastery.com/tools
- Honey: https://www.doharoastery.com/honey
- Coffee journal (Arabic): https://www.doharoastery.com/blog
- Coffee journal (English): https://www.doharoastery.com/blog?lang=en
- Wholesale program: https://www.doharoastery.com/wholesale
- About: https://www.doharoastery.com/about
- Contact: https://www.doharoastery.com/contact

## Coffee knowledge

The coffee journal explains commercial coffee species, notable Arabica varieties,
growing regions, and processing. Species, varieties, origins, roast levels, and
brewing methods are distinct concepts. Tasting notes describe possible sensory
impressions rather than guaranteed flavours or added ingredients. Articles link
to further reading; they are not an exhaustive botanical catalogue.
